svg.text: Woodland species and age | PR12 -> larger stands
CPU population diagram - equal bounds and scale; not a game screenshot or canopy coverage map
Solid = canonical trunk; hollow = decorative tree; tiny dot = shrub. Dashed amber = proposed candidate clearing cores on BOTH maps.
Candidate target population: 256 accepted radius>0 stems with standId + familyRole; pine 74.2% / oak 20.3% / fir+birch 5.5%.
The 75 / 20 / 5 field weights apply to that stand population. Preserved trees elsewhere are drawn too; PR12 has no standId/familyRole denominator.
Plot: x[-260,-40], z[-115,125], 2.5 px/m. Dashed grey = original woodland safety envelope; route shown only where it crosses the plot.
Marker radius is an age symbol, not physical crown/trunk size. Empty point space does not prove sky, grass, shadow, collision or rendered canopy clearance.
Inputs: pr12-metrics.json and larger-stands-metrics.json; current local source hashes verified. Three 0.186.1. Original Tervain placement data only.
